Jungheinrich was founded in 1953 in Hamburg by Dr. Friedrich Jungheinrich as a family business. Today, we are one of the world's leading intralogistics companies with a unique product portfolio: from conventional industrial trucks to fully automated solutions intralogistics companies. Headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, Jungheinrich is represented by its own direct sales companies in 41 countries and by partner companies in around 80 other countries around the world, and employs more than 19,000 people internationally.
 About the Role:
 We are looking for a SAP Cloud Security Expert (m/w/d) to help shape and secure our future SAP landscape as part of a global digitalization and SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
 In this role, you will design, implement, and continuously enhance security and authorization concepts across SAP cloud and hybrid environments. Working closely with experienced authorization managers, developers, business stakeholders, and project teams, you will ensure secure and compliant access management while supporting the adoption of modern SAP cloud technologies.
 Key Responsibilities:
Design and implement SAP Cloud Security and authorization concepts across hybrid SAP landscapes.
Define secure integration between SAP Cloud solutions, SAP on-premise systems, and SAP Cloud Identity Services.
Drive the implementation and rollout of cloud security solutions.
Support daily operations by managing authorization requests, resolving access issues, and ensuring stable system performance.
Advise business users, developers, and project teams on SAP Cloud Security best practices.
Contribute to the ongoing improvement of security standards and governance frameworks.
Support knowledge sharing and actively participate in the SAP security community.
 Required Qualifications:
Experience with SAP Cloud Security, SAP authorizations, or Identity & Access Management.
Knowledge of SAP BTP and SAP cloud-based solutions.
Understanding of authorization concepts and security governance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
Collaborative and team-oriented mindset.
 Experience:
2-5 years of experience in SAP Security, Cloud Security, IAM, or Authorization Management is highly valued.
 Why Join Us?
Be part of a global SAP S/4HANA transformation.
Work with the latest SAP cloud technologies.
Collaborate with international teams and experts.
Gain exposure to modern cloud security and identity management solutions.
Shape the future SAP security landscape of a global organization.
